goal: ASP501's statement-spine pass stops reporting short coincidental spines as clones: parallel typed variants and the guard/copy/sort preamble idiom stay silent, while a genuine 6+-statement copied block still fires.
acceptance_criteria: ASP501 violating fixture (a genuine 6+-statement copied block in two otherwise-different functions) is committed
ASP501 satisfying fixture (holding both lobaria shapes: parallel typed `push` variants and the stats/median sort-preamble idiom) is committed
the dup-check fires ASP501 on its violating fixture and exits 1
the dup-check is silent for ASP501 on its satisfying fixture and exits 0

acceptance_tests.description: the dup-check fires ASP501 on its violating 6+-statement copied block and exits 1
the dup-check is silent for ASP501 on its satisfying fixture (both lobaria shapes) and exits 0

problem: Aspergillus ships a Rust gate over a Cargo workspace. ASP501's statement-spine pass (asp-2d6.2) reported short coincidental spines as clones: a four-statement spine shared by two `push` methods differing only in the count newtype they construct, and a three-statement guard/copy/sort preamble shared by two unrelated analytics routines. Neither has a non-harmful shared-helper extraction. This spec pins that the spine pass now skips a window shared only by parallel typed variants (equal type-erased whole bodies) and the guard/copy/sort preamble idiom, while still firing on a genuine 6+-statement copied block - graded deterministically against the integration branch with committed violating/satisfying fixtures.
